# 12kebaad.in

> 12kebaad.in is an independent, free career and education guidance portal for Indian students after completing Class 12.

## About the Platform
12kebaad.in provides comprehensive, fact-checked roadmaps, entrance exam insights, college directories, and course guides across Science (PCM/PCB), Commerce, and Arts & Humanities.
